description: Build the GitHub API client used by all polling and hydration code. Use the Octokit REST client or raw fetch with PAT auth (Authorization: Bearer). Implement a paginate() helper that follows link headers until exhausted. Define the error taxonomy: RateLimitError (429, x-ratelimit-remaining=0), SecondaryRateLimitError (403 with retry-after), NetworkError, NotFoundError, AuthError. This taxonomy is used by T-036 for retry/backoff logic.
title: GitHub API client (PAT auth, pagination, rate limit + error taxonomy)
